APPROVE
The three extracted helpers (`WorkspaceDirsByName`, `TransitiveWorkspaceDeps`, `ReportChangeFilters` / `ChangeFilterSite`) move out the nested loops that account for roughly 17 points, leaving `ChangeFilters` around 12, and the logic is carried over unchanged (including the `d != dir` check and the `reported.Add` guard). The one thing I couldn't check is the build: the source file isn't on this machine, so the parameter types in the new signatures (`HashSet<TestInvocation>` for `runs`, `JsInventory.Inventory`, `CiChangeFilter`, `List<Site>`) need confirming against the real declarations.
